settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Open the settings centre to configure the model; the current language and default granularity show here.
settings.center.title: Settings
settings.center.intro: This page decides which model explains, which language is used and whether the app may go online. Changes apply to the explanation engine immediately; no recorded execution receipt is rewritten.
settings.center.load_failed: Settings could not be read: the server reports the reason (a broken file is never overwritten).
settings.center.offline: Offline / demo mode: there is no server to write to, this page is read-only.
settings.center.saved: Saved. The explanation engine now follows the new configuration.
settings.field.readonly_note: This identity has no settings.write: read only (the server refuses the same way).
settings.model.hint: Template mode needs no external service; llm mode calls the model configured here.
settings.model.mode_hint: Template mode sends no network request at all.
settings.model.base_url_hint: Remote must be https; loopback may use http. Example: https + host + prefix /v1.
settings.model.key_hint: Echoed as a mask only. Windows stores a DPAPI-encrypted blob; containers / team mode inject it from an environment variable.
settings.model.key_keep: Keep current (leave blank for no change)
settings.model.timeout_hint: 0.5–120 seconds. A timeout reports a readable reason instead of spinning.
settings.model.outbound_hint: Off by default: loopback only. Turning it on sends redacted facts to the address you entered (never the secret).
settings.model.test_hint: The test sends one self-check prompt, no business data; the result says so.
settings.model.engine_will_run: Fully configured: the model will be called when explaining.
settings.model.engine_wont_run: The model will not be called (template mode, or base URL / model / secret missing).
settings.model.saved_notice: After saving, the engine follows the new configuration; recorded execution receipts are never rewritten.
settings.language.hint: The interface language switches together with the explanation language; facts recorded in Chinese are not translated.
settings.data.hint: Clearing only affects demo records; the audit log is append-only and stays.
settings.data.reset_note: Clearing calls POST /api/reset: it needs data.write and can be disabled with --no-reset.
settings.data.reset_confirm: Clear the demo records? This cannot be undone (audit entries stay).
settings.data.export_note: Export calls GET /api/records and downloads the current JSON in the browser; no new server endpoint.
settings.data.audit_note: The audit log is append-only: PUT/DELETE always answer 405.
settings.team.mode.local: Local single user: no sign-in; the file on this machine holds ciphertext only.
settings.team.mode.team: Team mode: only admin may change settings; editor / viewer are read-only.
settings.team.can_write_false: You ({role}) may only read the masked view.
settings.security.mask_note: Every surface, log and audit entry shares one mask: bullets + last 4 characters + 12-character fingerprint prefix.
settings.security.file_note: The file holds only the DPAPI blob and the mask; the plaintext secret is never written, logged or audited.
settings.note.can_write: You have settings.write and may save.
settings.note.readonly: The server runs with --settings-readonly: changes are not persisted.
settings.note.team: Team mode: changing settings requires admin.
settings.note.local: Local mode: the person on this machine may change their own model configuration.
settings.note.audit_append_only: Audit is append-only: PUT / DELETE are refused.
settings.note.test_probe_only: The connection test sends one self-check prompt, no business data.
settings.test_llm.probe_only: One self-check prompt was sent; real generation sends redacted facts.
settings.effect.engine_only: Settings only change how explanations are generated, never recorded facts or receipts.
settings.error.settings_body_not_object: The settings payload must be an object (not an array or plain text).
settings.error.settings_body_empty: No fields to change were received.
settings.error.settings_section_unknown: Unknown settings section: only model, ui and data are accepted.
settings.error.settings_field_unknown: That field cannot be set (the server does not know it).
settings.error.settings_field_type: That field has the wrong type: follow the input hint.
settings.error.settings_field_range: That number is outside the allowed range: follow the stated bounds.
settings.error.settings_field_missing: A required field is missing: llm mode needs a base URL and a model name.
settings.error.settings_field_empty: This field must not be empty.
settings.error.settings_field_too_long: This field is too long: shorten it and try again.
settings.error.settings_mode_invalid: The explanation mode is either template or llm.
settings.error.settings_provider_invalid: That provider kind is not in the allowlist.
settings.error.settings_language_invalid: Only Chinese (zh) or English (en) is supported.
settings.error.settings_granularity_invalid: The default granularity is L1, L2 or L3.
settings.error.settings_url_malformed: The base URL is malformed: it needs scheme + host[:port] + path prefix.
settings.error.settings_url_scheme: Only https is accepted (loopback may use http).
settings.error.settings_url_insecure: Remote addresses must use https: the secret travels with the request, plaintext http is not allowed remotely.
settings.error.settings_url_port: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
settings.error.settings_url_query: Do not put a query string in the base URL (parameters end up in logs).
settings.error.settings_url_fragment: Do not put a # fragment in the base URL.
settings.error.settings_url_userinfo: The base URL must not embed credentials: the secret belongs in the secret field.
settings.error.settings_write_failed: The settings file cannot be written: check the directory permissions; the server never drops your settings silently.
settings.error.settings_read_failed: The settings file cannot be read.
settings.error.settings_file_invalid: The settings file is not valid JSON: the server kept it untouched, fix it and restart.
settings.error.llm_mode_template: Template mode sends no request. Switch to llm mode first, then test.
settings.error.llm_not_configured: The base URL or model name is missing; no request was sent.
settings.error.llm_key_missing: The remote model has no secret: on Windows store it once, in containers / team mode inject it from an environment variable.
settings.error.llm_outbound_blocked: The target is not a local address and zero-outbound is on. Enable allow outbound explicitly if you really mean it.
settings.error.llm_timeout: The model endpoint timed out. Raise the timeout, use a local model or lower max reply tokens.
settings.error.llm_unreachable: The model endpoint is unreachable: check that it runs, and that the address and port are right (loopback only by default).
settings.error.llm_http_error: The model endpoint returned an error status; see the redacted detail field.
settings.error.llm_key_rejected: The model endpoint rejected the secret: check that it matches the provider.
settings.error.llm_path_not_found: The path prefix is wrong: the endpoint has no such path. OpenAI-compatible bases usually end at /v1.
settings.error.llm_rate_limited: The model endpoint is rate limiting; try again later.
settings.error.llm_empty_answer: The connection worked but the model returned no text: the model name is probably wrong, or it rejects this prompt.
settings.error.llm_client_error: An unexpected error happened while calling the model (the reason is redacted; the engine fell back to templates).
settings.error.llm_transport_misconfigured: The injected test transport returned something unintelligible (automated tests only).

auth.panel.title: Sign in
auth.panel.intro: Team mode needs an account before anyone sees data. On your own machine use local mode (--mode local), no sign-in.
auth.panel.bootstrap_note: First start: the admin's initial password is printed once on the server console; no web endpoint can read it.

auth.users.title: User administration
auth.users.intro: Create accounts, change roles, disable them, reset passwords. Disable only - never delete: deleting leaves the audit trail without a person.
auth.users.feedback.idle: Changes apply at once; the audit records this account.
auth.users.note: Passwords never appear on the page, and never enter the audit, logs or responses.

import.paste.label: Paste JSON
import.paste.placeholder: Paste the JSON of a Langfuse / OTel / MCP / native trace here
import.aria.file: Choose a trace file to import
import.aria.mode: How records that already exist are handled
import.chip.durable: Records are stored durably (they survive a restart)
import.chip.memory: Memory only: a restart goes back to the demo data
import.state.size: Currently {bytes} bytes (batch cap {limit} bytes, at most {records} records)
import.state.file_ready: Read {filename} ({bytes} bytes); press Import to write it in
import.file.none: No file chosen (pasting works as well)
import.mode.upsert: Update if present, insert if not
import.mode.note.upsert: upsert: the same id merges an update; a decision you already made and its execution receipt are never overwritten by imported data.
import.mode.note.create: create: an id that already exists is skipped and counted as duplicates in the result.
import.mode.note.update: update: only ids that already exist are touched; new ids are not inserted.

import.summary.durable: Written to the durable store; still there after a restart.
import.summary.memory: Memory only: a restart goes back to the demo data.
import.note.need_permission: This role has no data.write permission, so nothing can be imported (editor or admin is needed).
import.note.offline: Offline preview (file:// or ?api=off): no request is sent and nothing is written.
import.validation.empty: The paste box is empty: paste JSON, or choose a file.
import.validation.too_large: The text is {bytes} bytes, over the {limit}-byte batch cap; split it before importing.
import.validation.not_json: This does not look like valid JSON ({bytes} bytes). Check quotes, commas and brackets before importing.
import.validation.file_too_large: The file is {bytes} bytes, over the {limit}-byte batch cap.
import.error.no_file_reader: This browser cannot read local files (no FileReader). Paste the content into the text box.
import.error.file_read_failed: Reading {filename} failed. Make sure it is a UTF-8 JSON file.

import.error.too_large: This batch is too large: {bytes} bytes, cap {limit} bytes ({code}).
import.error.too_many: More events than the batch allows ({code}); split it into smaller batches.
import.error.format_unsupported: The format was not recognised ({code}). Supported: langfuse / otel_genai / mcp_events / native.
import.error.mode_invalid: mode must be create / update / upsert ({code}).
import.error.store_locked: The record store is held by another process ({code}); try again shortly.
import.error.store_write_failed: The record write failed: the store is not writable ({code}). Nothing was imported, so no data is half-written.
import.error.store_line_invalid: A line of the record journal cannot be read ({code}). The page is read-only: it never rewrites the file.
import.error.store_record_invalid: One record in the journal is invalid ({code}); it is skipped and the rest load normally.
import.error.role_forbidden: This role may not import data ({code}).
import.error.csrf_failed: The CSRF check failed, the import was refused ({code}); reload the page and try again.
import.error.network_error: The service is unreachable, nothing was sent ({code}).
import.error.timeout: The import timed out ({code}). The server may still be writing; refresh the list to check.
import.error.http_status: The service answered with an unexpected status ({code}).
import.error.route_not_found: This service has no import route ({code}); update the server.
import.error.content_type: Wrong request type: import needs application/json ({code}).
import.error.internal_error: Server-side internal error; the import did not finish ({code}).
import.error.store_line_too_large: A journal line is larger than the cap ({code}). The page is read-only: it never rewrites the file.

import.error.store_op_unknown: The journal holds an operation this build does not know ({code}); it is skipped.

secretariat.honesty.title: What this page does not pretend
secretariat.honesty.p1: Signatures are pure in-process Ed25519 (no HSM or TEE); private keys stay in the local keyring.json and the API returns only the public key and its fingerprint.
secretariat.honesty.p2: The timestamp is local-tsa (the local clock), not an RFC 3161 trusted timestamp; verification reports tsa_state=local_only.
secretariat.honesty.p3: An approval signature only proves that this approval was recorded and signed locally; it does not prove real-world consent.
secretariat.honesty.p4: The ledger is append-only: revocation appends a state instead of deleting history, and a broken chain is reported, never rebuilt.
secretariat.honesty.p5: When the server is unreachable this page shows nothing; it never fills the gap with sample data.
secretariat.gate.settings_write: This role lacks settings.write, so write buttons are disabled here (the server would answer 403 as well).
